rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS_Profile {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS based on JA3/S patterns and URI entropy"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $s1 = "GET /" wide
        $s2 = "Host:" wide
        $s3 = "Connection: Keep-Alive" wide
        $xored_stage = { 66 81 C? ?? ?? 66 39 C? 75 ?? 8B C? 83 C? 02 } // Common x86 decryption loop
    condition:
        all of ($s*) and $xored_stage and filesize < 500KB
}
